sudo_conf_plugins.description: List of sudo.conf plugin entries (name, path, optional args)

env_reset.description: Reset user environment to minimal defaults (true = secure; false = inherit all unless denied)

env_check.description: List of regex patterns to match env vars whose *values* must be checked (e.g., bash functions)

env_delete.description: List of regex patterns for env vars to remove from the user's environment

env_keep.description: List of env var name patterns to preserve from user's environment

secure_path.description: Safe PATH used for command execution (overrides user's PATH)

set_logname.description: Force LOGNAME/USER to target user, overriding SUDO_USER

always_set_home.description: Always set HOME to target user's home directory

set_home.description: Enable -H to set HOME to target user's home (default with -i)

setenv.description: Allow user to preserve environment with -E (default: false unless overridden)

timestamp_timeout.description: Number of minutes to cache sudo authentication

logfile.description: Path to sudo log file (empty = use syslog only)

syslog.description: Syslog facility to use (e.g., auth, authpriv, local0, etc.)

log_allowed.description: Log allowed/successful commands (default is to log all)

log_denied.description: Log denied/failed attempts (default is to log all)

mailto.description: Email address to notify about unauthorized sudo attempts

mail_always.description: Always send mail on sudo events (success or failure)

restricted_env_file.description: Path to restricted environment file (applied before user env)

env_file.description: Path to unrestricted environment file (applied last)

rootpw.description: Require root password instead of user’s password

targetpw.description: Require target user’s password instead of invoking user’s

runaspw.description: Require the target user (specified by -u) to authenticate

error_recovery.description: Attempt recovery from syntax errors (true = ignore bad lines; false = fail hard)

ignore_perms.description: Disable permission checks on sudoers file (dangerous; for testing only)

ldap_conf.description: Override path to ldap.conf file (for LDAP sudoers)

ldap_secret.description: Override path to ldap.secret file (for LDAP sudoers)

sudoers_uid.description: Expected numeric UID for sudoers file ownership

sudoers_gid.description: Expected numeric GID for sudoers file group

sudoers_mode.description: Expected octal mode for sudoers file (e.g., 0440 → 288)

log_servers.description: List of hosts to forward sudo logs (requires sudo_logsrvd or compatible)

user_aliases.description: User aliases in the form {name, members: []}

runas_aliases.description: Runas aliases in the form {name, members: []}

host_aliases.description: Host aliases in the form {name, members: []}

cmnd_aliases.description: Command aliases in the form {name, commands: []}

user_specs.description: User specifications: who may run what commands on which hosts as whom
